dataset.name: chap-core example data: nicaragua_weekly_data
dataset.description: Weekly dengue cases per department for 10 Nicaraguan departments (OpenDengue, WHO/PAHO source), with raw ERA5-Land weather and a synthetic population column, from chap-core example_data.
dataset.notes: Built by chap-core scripts/open_dengue/nicaragua.py (commit 453ae5b5). Cases are at department level (admin 1). Weather was pulled from GEE ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR without unit conversion: mean_temperature is in K and rainfall is mean daily total precipitation in metres. The 10 kept locations are exactly the departments whose name is also a GADM 4.1 admin 2 (municipality) name; the 5 other mainland departments (Carazo, Chontales, Madriz, Nueva Segovia, Río San Juan) are missing although they exist at GADM admin 1. The script calls get_area_polygons(country, names, 2), so the weather is likely for the homonymous municipality polygon, not the whole department. population is random: 100000 + randint(1000). time_period is a Monday–Sunday week; the OpenDengue week that starts on Sunday D is the week that ends on D (6-day label shift). Dropped the pandas index column (first, unnamed) from the source file; otherwise unchanged.
dataset.schema_status: filled from source code/docs and data checks; not independently verified

source.notes: From OpenDengue calendar_start_date (a Sunday) via chap_core Week; data check: the OpenDengue week starting on Sunday D matches the row whose week ends on D.

fields.name: rainfall
fields.description: Mean daily total precipitation over the week (ERA5-Land total_precipitation_sum, mean of daily images, then spatial mean over the polygon), not converted to mm. Multiply by 7 for a weekly total.

source.provider: ERA5-Land daily aggregates via Google Earth Engine (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR)
source.notes: scripts/open_dengue/nicaragua.py uses gee_era5(..., ['temperature_2m', 'total_precipitation_sum']); gee_raw.fetch_single_period applies collection.mean() then reduceRegions(mean) with no converter. Data: 3e-7 to 0.077, yearly sum of weekly values 0.16 to 0.24, i.e. about 1.1 to 1.7 m/year after x7. Per the code at 453ae5b5 the mean covers Mon-Sat (6 days: GEE filterDate end is exclusive), so x7 is only an approximate weekly total.

fields.name: mean_temperature
fields.description: Mean 2m air temperature over the week within the polygon (ERA5-Land temperature_2m), not converted to °C.

source.provider: ERA5-Land daily aggregates via Google Earth Engine (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR)
source.notes: Same code path as rainfall, no kelvin_to_celsium conversion. Data: 290.7 to 305.0. Per the code at 453ae5b5 the mean covers Mon-Sat (6 days: GEE filterDate end is exclusive), so x7 is only an approximate weekly total.

fields.name: disease_cases
fields.description: Reported dengue cases per department and week (OpenDengue dengue_total).

source.notes: All 9800 non-empty values equal OpenDengue V1.2.2 dengue_total for NICARAGUA, S_res Admin1, T_res Week (UUIDs WHOPAHO-NIC-20042022-W01-*), after the 6-day week label shift.

fields.name: population
fields.description: Synthetic placeholder, not real population: random integers in [100000, 101000). Do not use.

source.notes: scripts/open_dengue/nicaragua.py: joined['population'] = 100000 + np.random.randint(1000, size=len(joined)). Data: 100000 to 100999.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Department name, lower case (chap-core normalize_name of OpenDengue adm_1_name).
